openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.character: Advisory: The advisor session, planner, child advisor, and primary builder model at xhigh reasoning. Use Astra xhigh for decision-bearing implementation, substantial builds, and every kind of UX work with frontend-design loaded. Review and reduction are Sol xhigh, not Astra. Prefer Sol high when an execution packet has already locked the approach and material decisions.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.character: Advisory: The procedural-tier workhorse at high reasoning for mechanical chores, routine mid-phase checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, and implementation from a locked execution packet; at xhigh it is the fresh-context reviewer and reducer, including adversarial checks on schema, auth, security, money, and data boundaries. The packet must fix the material approach, bound the surface, and name deterministic anchors. Sol owns ordinary local code choices, resolves environment and tooling obstacles locally and records them under Deviations, and stops and escalates rather than deciding product, architecture, schema, migration, auth, product-fallback, destructive, or external-effect behavior. Generally avoid decision-bearing implementation at high. Recommended reasoning is high for procedural work and xhigh for review and reduction.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.character: Advisory: The scouting and browser-verification model at max reasoning for bounded investigation, browser exercise, and evidence capture.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: Advisory: High-efficiency generalist at high reasoning, kept as the alternate for research and bounded backend or mixed-stack work when Codex capacity is tight. UX work routes to Astra, not Grok. 200K window — keep packets bounded and split oversized work. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default. This guide recommends Cursor only as cursor/grok-4.6.

scout.fit: Preferred for bounded investigation in this profile.

planner.fit: Preferred for planning at xhigh reasoning.

reducer.fit: Preferred for synthesis and conflict reduction in this profile.

builder.fit: Preferred for all decision-bearing implementation, including substantial builds and all UX work with frontend-design loaded; prefer Sol high for a locked execution packet.
Preferred cheap executor for a locked execution packet: fixed approach, bounded surface, deterministic anchors, and stop-on-material-ambiguity.
Alternate for bounded backend or mixed-stack work when Codex capacity is tight.

advisor.fit: Preferred for bounded end-to-end work with delegated internal steps in this profile.

checker.fit: Preferred fresh-context review choice in this profile, including adversarial checks on schema, auth, security, money, and data boundaries.
Alternate for routine mid-phase checks and repair verification.

browser-verifier.fit: Preferred for browser verification in this profile.
